Building a farm of 195 keys therefore exposes the whole ladder of sponsors, and each sponsor's bond is forfeit along with the leaf. A slashed identity's forfeiture propagates up to 6 levels of its sponsorship chain, so the member who vouched for it loses too and so does the member above that. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
